get.description: Changes in the order they were made, oldest first: records added, corrected or withdrawn, texts published, legal effects recorded, coverage changes, and reviewed memberships and suspensions recorded. Keep the `resume_token` and send it next time for only newer changes. Send at most one of `cursor`, `resume_token` and `start`. The same route answers without a key at https://open.alvary.ai/api/changes.

get.description: One jurisdiction on a date. For a country, `member_of`: the African Union and the regional bodies it belonged to on `as_of`, in `uncertain` those it may or may not have belonged to (the date falls inside an uncertain first or last day), and in `ended` the memberships that had ended by then, each with its first and last day (as precisely as the evidence gives them, with their bounds), its basis, evidence and review, and its suspensions from participation as context. For the African Union or a regional body, `members`: its member states on that date, and those that had left. Only reviewed memberships are listed; `status` is `unknown`, never an empty list, when none is reviewed. A suspension never ends a membership. Membership alone never means a body's treaties apply to a member.

relation.description: `national` (its own law; for a place within a country, such as `ng-la`, its country's law too); `regional_direct`, `regional_requires_transposition` or `regional_binding_on_addressees` (an instrument of a body it belonged to on the date, by its legal effect); `treaty_in_force_for_state` or `treaty_not_in_force_for_state` (by its own ratification or accession, never by membership of a body; missing from the party list, only when the list is complete on the date); `non_binding`; `comparative` (another jurisdiction's law, an instrument addressed to other states, or of a body it was not a member of on the date); or `unknown` (the membership, legal effect or ratification is not reviewed, the state is missing from a party list not known to be complete, or a date cannot be compared).

transposed_by.title: Transposed By

the reviewed memberships, the instrument's legal effect and the state's entry in the treaty's party
list. ``binds`` is ``bound``, ``not_bound`` or ``unknown``; whether the text is in force is

within.title: Within

date_basis.title: Date Basis

membership.title: Membership

bodies.title: Bodies
bodies.description: Each body it has a reviewed membership of, with whether it held on the date. Only the law of bodies `held` was added.

admitted.title: Admitted
admitted.description: How many records of other jurisdictions were added, besides the law of `within`.

left_out.title: Left Out

notices.title: Notices

reviewed membership of, with whether it held on the date (only the law of bodies ``held`` was added),

relation.

reviewer_qualification.title: Reviewer Qualification

reviewer's legal qualification (EDT-01).

it: on ``court``, on the jurisdiction's courts generally (null), or with ``members`` on the courts of

unique.title: Unique

heading_path.title: Heading Path

definitions.title: Definitions

qualifications.title: Qualifications

expanded_from.title: Expanded From

EvidenceCourt.description:

(CPR-04), with the court's own review, and how its decisions bear on other courts on the date assessed.

records_with_text.title: Records With Text

dense_coverage.title: Dense Coverage

unsupported.title: Unsupported

end_byte.title: End Byte

EvidenceDefinition.title: EvidenceDefinition
EvidenceDefinition.description: A definition in force for a term the unit uses (RSV-06, derived): its exact words and span.

revisions.description: Everything the answer depends on; the same request and revisions give the same answer.

catalogue.title: Catalogue
catalogue.description: Records that match but have no published text: identity and official link only.

next_steps.title: Next Steps
next_steps.description: Hints for a follow-up request, such as an ambiguous citation's candidates.

bytes.description: The words sent: unique bytes (each span once), bytes as transmitted, and the budget.

applicability.description: With `scope=applicable`: the widening applied, and what it rests on and left out.

needed to check it and the revisions it depends on. Never a generated answer.

effective_date.title: Effective Date
effective_date.description: When the link took effect, when known.

scope.title: Scope

EvidenceQualification.description: A reviewed link that qualifies the unit's work: it was amended, repealed or superseded.

routes.title: Routes
routes.description: The routes taken, in order: `link` (the query is an Open Alvary or official address), `citation`, `page` (a page of one law's official file), `instrument`, `definition`, `topic`, and the modifiers `historical` and `comparative`.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: The filters applied, as given or as your plan set them; `scope` when asked for (the widening it applied is in `applicability`).

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: The date asked about, when given.

pinpoint.title: Pinpoint
pinpoint.description: The provision referred to, such as `s. 23`.

EvidenceReference.title: EvidenceReference
EvidenceReference.description: A provision of the same text that the unit refers to by number (RSV-06, derived).

dataset.title: Dataset

engine.title: Engine

vector.title: Vector

reranker.title: Reranker

pinpoint.title: Pinpoint

citation.title: Citation

official_url.title: Official Url

retrieved_at.title: Retrieved At

original_sha256.title: Original Sha256

page_end.title: Page End

links.description: Where to read the unit: on the website, by the API, and the whole text.

text.title: Text
text.description: The words: exactly the text's bytes from `text_start_byte` to `text_end_byte`.

text_start_byte.title: Text Start Byte

text_end_byte.title: Text End Byte

start_byte.title: Start Byte

end_byte.title: End Byte
end_byte.description: Where the whole unit ends: a byte offset into the text in UTF-8.

licence.title: Licence

attribution_text.title: Attribution Text

EvidenceUnit.title: EvidenceUnit
EvidenceUnit.description:
One unit of legal evidence (RSV-07): which part of which published text, its exact words (or an
excerpt within the byte budget), the hashes to check them, where it is in the original file and
where to read it, what quoting asks for, whether it was in force, and why it ranks where it does.

language_rule.description: The instrument's own rule for which version prevails where its language versions differ, as the record states it.

items.title: Items
items.description: Its language editions with a public text.

authority.title: Authority
authority.description: What the edition is worth as law, as the record states it: `authoritative` (the only authoritative text), `equally_authentic` (one of several equally authentic texts), `official_translation`, `unofficial_translation`, `machine_translation`, or `unknown` when nothing is recorded.

authority_evidence.description: Where that authority is stated, when recorded.

preferred_version_id.title: Preferred Version Id
preferred_version_id.description: The text to read when no date is given, when one can be named; else absent.

preferred_reason.title: Preferred Reason
preferred_reason.description: Why: `only_text`, `in_force_today` (the one text in force today, every text dated), or, when none is preferred, `several_texts` or `dates_unknown`.

ExpressionView.title: ExpressionView
ExpressionView.description:
One language edition of a record (API-02 expressions): its public texts, the one to read when no
date is given, and what the edition is worth as law as its record states it, with where; ``unknown``
when the record states nothing. A preferred text is a reading default, never a claim of authority.

id.title: Id
id.description: The jurisdiction's ID, such as `ng`, or `aa-ecowas` for a regional body.

country_code.title: Country Code
country_code.description: Its ISO country code, such as `NG`; null for the African Union and the regional bodies.

parent_id.title: Parent Id
parent_id.description: The country a state or region belongs to.

member_of.description: For a country: the African Union and regional bodies it belongs to on `as_of`.

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: The date the memberships are given for.

members.description: For the African Union or a regional body: its members on `as_of`.

JurisdictionDetail.title: JurisdictionDetail
JurisdictionDetail.description: One jurisdiction on a date (API /jurisdictions/{id}): a country's bodies, or a body's members.

id.title: Id
id.description: The jurisdiction's ID, such as `ng`, or `aa-ecowas` for a regional body.

country_code.title: Country Code
country_code.description: Its ISO country code, such as `NG`; null for the African Union and the regional bodies.

parent_id.title: Parent Id
parent_id.description: The country a state or region belongs to.

member_of.description: For a country: the bodies it belongs to on `as_of`, reviewed memberships only.

id.title: Id
id.description: The key's ID, `key_` and 32 hexadecimal characters, as the console shows it; for a connected app, its grant's ID (`grt_…`). Never the secret.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: `personal` (a person's key, which stops when they leave the organisation), `service` (a shared key for servers, which belongs to the organisation) or `app` (a connected app's access token).

name.title: Name
name.description: The key's name in the console, or the connected app's name.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: When the key was created, or the app connected.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: When the key stops working. A rotated key's is the end of its overlap. Null for a connected app, which works until it is disconnected.

replaced.title: Replaced
replaced.description: Whether a rotation has replaced the key: it works until `expires_at`, so switch to its replacement before then.

entitlement.description: Your organisation's access, as this request was admitted under it.

KeyView.title: KeyView
KeyView.description:
The credential that sent a request to REST v1 (GET /key): an API key, or a connected app's grant.
Never its secret, its hash or any other credential's data.

status.title: Status
status.description: `stated` (the instrument states a rule), `not_stated` (the reviewed copy states none), `not_applicable`, or `unknown` (nothing is recorded).

rule.title: Rule
rule.description: The rule, as the instrument states it.

prevails.title: Prevails
prevails.description: The language whose version prevails where versions differ, when the rule names one; absent when it names none, as when every version is equally authentic.

provision.title: Provision
provision.description: Where the instrument states it, such as `Article 42`.

evidence.description: Where the rule is stated: its page and words, or the instrument's address.

LanguageRuleView.title: LanguageRuleView
LanguageRuleView.description:
The instrument's own rule for divergence between its language versions (LNG-03, DAT-07), as its
record states it: ``stated``, with the rule, the language whose version prevails when it names one,
where it is stated and the evidence; ``not_stated``, the reviewed copy states none;
``not_applicable``; or ``unknown``, nothing is recorded.

effective_date.title: Effective Date
effective_date.description: When the link took effect, when known.

LinkedAct.title: LinkedAct
LinkedAct.description:
A public record a checked link names (EDT-01), such as a national act that domesticates a treaty or
transposes a directive.

id.title: Id
id.description: The reviewed membership, such as `sn:aa-ecowas:1`; Get a jurisdiction gives its dates and evidence.

held.title: Held
held.description: Whether the jurisdiction was a member on the date: `held`, `not_held`, or `unknown` when the date falls in an uncertain window of the membership's dates.

MembershipBasis.title: MembershipBasis
MembershipBasis.description:
A reviewed membership an applicable-law answer rests on: its ID, the body, and whether the
jurisdiction was a member of that body on the date asked about: ``held``, ``not_held``, or ``unknown``
when the date falls in an uncertain window of the membership's dates. /jurisdictions/{id} gives its
dates, evidence and review.

status.title: Status
status.description: `reviewed`: the memberships listed are reviewed facts. `unknown`: none is reviewed yet, which never means none exists.

items.title: Items
items.description: The memberships held on the date.

uncertain.title: Uncertain
uncertain.description: The memberships that may or may not have held on the date: it falls inside the window of an uncertain first or last day. Unknown, never guessed.

ended.title: Ended
ended.description: The reviewed memberships that had certainly ended before the date, with their last day.

notice.title: Notice
notice.description: What the list covers, in a sentence.

MembershipList.title: MembershipList
MembershipList.description:
Memberships in one direction on one date: the bodies a jurisdiction belongs to, or a body's members.
``items`` held on the date; ``uncertain`` may or may not have held (the date falls inside an uncertain
start or end); ``ended`` had ended by then. ``unknown`` when no membership in this direction is
reviewed: never an empty list read as "none".

id.title: Id
id.description: The membership's ID: member, body and period, such as `ml:aa-ecowas:1`.

member_id.title: Member Id
member_id.description: The member's jurisdiction ID, such as `ml`.

body_id.title: Body Id
body_id.description: The body's jurisdiction ID, such as `aa-ecowas`.

valid_from.title: Valid From
valid_from.description: The membership's first day, as an EDTF date: a day (`2001-05-26`), a month (`2000-12`), a year (`1976`) or a window holding the day (`[2016-08-15..2016-09-05]`: one day, unknown which, never a period), as precisely as the evidence gives it.

valid_from_bounds.description: The earliest and latest day `valid_from` can be, and its precision.

valid_to.title: Valid To
valid_to.description: Its last day, when it has ended (a withdrawal effective on 29 January ends it on the 28th), in the same forms; null when it has not.

valid_to_bounds.description: The earliest and latest day `valid_to` can be, and its precision; null when it has not ended.

basis.description: Why the membership starts when it does, with the article that makes that its start.

evidence_url.title: Evidence Url
evidence_url.description: The official source the dates were checked against: the body's own site or the treaty's depositary.

note.title: Note
note.description: What the evidence says, and anything a reader should know about the dates.

suspensions.title: Suspensions
suspensions.description: The member's reviewed suspensions from participation in the body, as context. A suspension never ends a membership: a suspended member is still listed as holding it.

MembershipView.title: MembershipView
MembershipView.description:
One reviewed membership of the African Union or a regional body (JUR-04): the member, the body, the
first and last day it held (inclusive; no last day means it has not ended), each an EDTF date (a day,
a month, a year or a window) with its bounds, why it starts then (``basis``), the evidence, who
reviewed it when, and its suspensions from participation, as context. Membership alone never applies
the body's treaties to the member; a suspension never ends it.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: What to do, in plain language.

id.title: Id
id.description: The part's ID.

version_id.title: Version Id
version_id.description: The text version it belongs to.

parent_id.title: Parent Id
parent_id.description: The part it sits in, if any.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: What it is: `document`, `preamble`, `contents`, `contents_entry`, `notice`, `title`, `part`, `chapter`, `division`, `article`, `section`, `subsection`, `definition`, `paragraph`, `subparagraph`, `schedule`, `annex`, `table`, or in a judgment `opinion` or `order`.

locator.title: Locator
locator.description: A stable key for it within the text, such as `sec_23__subsec_1`. The same provision keeps its locator in later versions of the text.

order.title: Order
order.description: Its position among the parts of the same parent.

start_byte.title: Start Byte
start_byte.description: Where it starts: a byte offset into `canonical_text` in UTF-8.

end_byte.title: End Byte
end_byte.description: Where it ends: a byte offset into `canonical_text` in UTF-8.

page.title: Page
page.description: The page of the official file it starts on, when known.

source_hash.title: Source Hash
source_hash.description: The `content_hash` of the text the offsets refer to.

label.title: Label
label.description: Its printed number, such as `23.` or `(1)`, when it has one.

heading.title: Heading
heading.description: Its printed heading, such as a section's margin note, when it has one.

page_end.title: Page End
page_end.description: The last page of the official file it reaches, when known.

span_hash.title: Span Hash
span_hash.description: SHA-256 of its own bytes from `start_byte` to `end_byte`, to check an exact quotation.

target_node_id.title: Target Node Id
target_node_id.description: For a contents entry, the part of the text it lists, when found.

pinpoint.title: Pinpoint
pinpoint.description: The part the citation names, as read, such as `s. 23(1)(a)`.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why not one part: `several_works`, `several_texts` (the part is in several texts, such as two languages: give `language` or `as_of`), `repeated_number` (the text prints the number twice), `not_found`, `no_public_text` or `no_text_in_scope` (no public text matches `as_of` or `language`).

candidates.title: Candidates
candidates.description: The part, or the parts that could each be the one.

nearest.description: When the part is not found: the nearest part enclosing it that is, such as the section of a paragraph the text doesn't divide.

ProvisionLookup.title: ProvisionLookup
ProvisionLookup.description:
What a citation's pinpoint names in the works it resolves to: one part, alternatives (never a
guess) or none, with the reason, and when none, the nearest enclosing part that exists.

anchor_id.title: Anchor Id
anchor_id.description: The part's ID: `/anchors/{anchor_id}` gives its words.

version_id.title: Version Id
version_id.description: The text version it is in.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: What it is, such as `section`, `paragraph` or `definition`.

locator.title: Locator
locator.description: Its stable key within the text, such as `sec_23__subsec_1__para_a`.

label.title: Label
label.description: Its printed number, such as `(a)`, when it has one.

heading.title: Heading
heading.description: Its printed heading, when it has one.

pinpoint.title: Pinpoint
pinpoint.description: How it is cited within the text, such as `s. 23(1)(a)`.

citation.title: Citation
citation.description: The record's citation and the pinpoint.

start_byte.title: Start Byte
start_byte.description: Where it starts: a byte offset into the text in UTF-8.

end_byte.title: End Byte
end_byte.description: Where it ends: a byte offset into the text in UTF-8.

span_hash.title: Span Hash
span_hash.description: SHA-256 of the text's bytes from `start_byte` to `end_byte`.

effective_from.title: Effective From
effective_from.description: The date the text applies from, when known.

effective_until.title: Effective Until
effective_until.description: The date the text applies until, when known.

ProvisionMatch.title: ProvisionMatch
ProvisionMatch.description:
One part of a public text that a pinpoint names (API-04 provision lookup): its anchor, locator and
exact span. /anchors/{anchor_id} gives its words.

instrument.title: Instrument
instrument.description: The instrument, such as `Constitutive Act of the African Union`.

role.title: Role
role.description: Why it is cited: `decision_basis`, the article the decision itself cites as its basis (read in the decision), or `treaty_rule`, the treaty's rule the suspension applies (read in the treaty), whether or not the decision names it.

evidence_url.title: Evidence Url
evidence_url.description: Where it was read: the decision, for `decision_basis`; the treaty, for `treaty_rule`.

quote.title: Quote
quote.description: The words read there, when recorded: the decision's citing the article, or the article's own.

ProvisionView.title: ProvisionView
ProvisionView.description:
An article a suspension rests on, as cited: the instrument, the article, why it is cited (the basis
the decision itself cites, or the treaty's rule it applies), where it was read and the words read
there when recorded.

arms.title: Arms
arms.description: Each search the unit came from and its rank there: `link`, `citation`, `page`, `instrument`, `definition`, `lexical` (every word), `lexical_any` (any word, rarer words weighing more; run when few units have every word), `document` or `dense` (meaning, where a semantic index is active).

fused_score.title: Fused Score
fused_score.description: The fused score after the signals: relevance, not legal authority.

rerank_score.title: Rerank Score
rerank_score.description: The reranker's score, when one ran.

features.title: Features
features.description: The search engine's ranking features for each search the unit came from, such as `bm25(words)` or `closeness(field, emb_…)`: the inputs to its rank there.

band.title: Band
band.description: The band of positions it was ordered within.

signals.title: Signals
signals.description: Each documented signal applied, with its value and effect.

diversification.title: Diversification
diversification.description: Anything diversification did, such as collapsing a duplicate into it.

RankingExplanation.title: RankingExplanation
RankingExplanation.description:
Why a unit is where it is (RSV-05): the route, each arm's rank, the fused score, the band, the
signals applied and any diversification. Mechanical, never a legal justification.

effect.title: Effect
effect.description: What it did, such as `x0.8` or `first`.

RankingSignal.title: RankingSignal
RankingSignal.description: One documented signal that moved a unit (RSV-05), with its value and effect.

organ.title: Organ
organ.description: The organ that adopted it, such as the Council of Ministers.

legal_effect.title: Legal Effect
legal_effect.description: `directly_applicable` (applies in the members as it stands), `requires_transposition` (binds the members as to its result, through national law), `binding_on_addressees` (binds the member states it is addressed to) or `non_binding`.

member_states.title: Member States
member_states.description: The member states it binds; empty means every member.

transposition_deadline.title: Transposition Deadline
transposition_deadline.description: The date by which members must transpose it, when one is set.

RegionalView.title: RegionalView
RegionalView.description: A regional instrument's legal effect, as its reviewed record states it (JUR-04, DAT-03).

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: How the other record relates to this one, from this one's side: `repeals`, `repealed_by`, `amends`, `amended_by`, `supersedes`, `superseded_by`, `commences`, `commenced_by`, `made_under`, `enables`, `transposes`, `transposed_by`, `domesticates`, `domesticated_by`, `implements`, `implemented_by`, `ratifies`, `ratified_by`, `cites`, `cited_by` or `cross_reference`; for judgments, `follows`, `applies`, `distinguishes`, `doubts` or `overrules` and `followed_by`, `applied_by`, `distinguished_by`, `doubted_by` or `overruled_by`. A kind and its `_by` form are the same link seen from each end. `cites` says only that one record refers to the other, never that it agrees with it or changes it. A treatment is a reviewer's reading of one paragraph, in the opinion it is in; it is never inferred from a citation, and overruling is not repeal.

citation.title: Citation
citation.description: How the other record is cited.

year.title: Year
year.description: The year the other record was made, when known.

effective_date.title: Effective Date
effective_date.description: When the link took effect, such as the date of a repeal or commencement, when known.

evidence_url.title: Evidence Url
evidence_url.description: The official text that makes the link (the repealing, amending, commencing or transposing law, for example; for a judgment's citation or treatment, the citing judgment).

verified.title: Verified
verified.description: Whether a reviewer checked the link against that text.

assertion_id.title: Assertion Id
assertion_id.description: For a judgment's citation or treatment: its ID. Absent on a link between whole records.

citing_locator.title: Citing Locator
citing_locator.description: The citing judgment's paragraph, by locator, such as `para_12` or `op_2__para_4`.

citing_pinpoint.title: Citing Pinpoint
citing_pinpoint.description: That paragraph as it is cited, such as `[12]` or `op. 2 [4]`.

cited_locator.title: Cited Locator
cited_locator.description: The part of the cited record the paragraph cites, by locator, such as `sec_2__subsec_1`; absent when it cites the record as a whole, or its pinpoint names no part of a public text.

cited_pinpoint.title: Cited Pinpoint
cited_pinpoint.description: That part as it is cited, such as `s. 2(1)` or `[4]`.

printed.title: Printed
printed.description: The citation as the paragraph writes it. Present only while the citing judgment's text is public.

quote.title: Quote
quote.description: The paragraph's words (or, for a long paragraph, the sentences around the citation); for a treatment, the passage that treats the other judgment. Present only while the citing judgment's text is public.

opinion.title: Opinion
opinion.description: For a treatment: the opinion its paragraph is in, as the reviewer recorded it: `majority`, `concurrence`, `dissent`, `plurality`, `order` or `unknown`. A dissent's words are not the court's holding.

review.description: Who checked it against the paragraph, at what level and when.

revisions.title: Revisions
revisions.description: Every revision of its rights record, newest first.

RightsHistory.title: RightsHistory
RightsHistory.description: Every revision of a record's rights record, newest first, never edited (OA-R1).

publication_revision.title: Publication Revision
publication_revision.description: The catalogue publication it was recorded with (0: the first baseline).

record.description: The rights record as it was.

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: The rights record's revision in its history, where a history is kept.

id.title: Id
id.description: The rights record's ID.

rights_holder.title: Rights Holder
rights_holder.description: Who holds the rights, when known.

licence.title: Licence
licence.description: The licence, when there is one.

redistribution_allowed.description: Whether the text may be redistributed: `yes`, `no`, `conditional` or `unknown`.

commercial_reuse_allowed.description: Whether it may be reused commercially: `yes`, `no`, `conditional` or `unknown`.

derivatives_allowed.description: Whether it may be adapted: `yes`, `no`, `conditional` or `unknown`.

attribution_required.title: Attribution Required
attribution_required.description: Whether reuse must credit the source.

attribution_text.title: Attribution Text
attribution_text.description: The credit to give, when one is required.

database_rights_notes.title: Database Rights Notes
database_rights_notes.description: Notes on database rights, when relevant.

privacy_status.title: Privacy Status
privacy_status.description: Whether personal data was checked: `pending`, `cleared`, `redacted` or `blocked`.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: When the decision must be reviewed again, if it lapses.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: Links to the evidence for the decision.

conditions_satisfied.title: Conditions Satisfied
conditions_satisfied.description: Whether the conditions are met here.

approved_content_hashes.title: Approved Content Hashes
approved_content_hashes.description: The `content_hash` of each text the decision covers.

metadata_public.title: Metadata Public
metadata_public.description: Whether the catalogue record may be shown.

metadata_basis.title: Metadata Basis
metadata_basis.description: Why the catalogue record may be shown.

records_in_scope.title: Records In Scope
records_in_scope.description: Public records in the search's scope.

records_with_text.title: Records With Text
records_with_text.description: Of those, records with a published text, which is all that is searched.

notice.title: Notice
notice.description: What the search covered, in a sentence.

SearchCoverage.title: SearchCoverage
SearchCoverage.description: What a text search covered: only published texts are searched, never a record's metadata alone.

scope.const: Catalogue metadata and cleared full text only
scope.title: Scope
scope.default: Catalogue metadata and cleared full text only
scope.description: What a search covers: catalogue metadata and cleared full text only.

notices.title: Notices
notices.description: Present when there is something to know about this search: published texts were not searched (the section index is being built, or that search took too long), or the query has no letters or digits to match.

legal_status.title: Legal Status
legal_status.description: Whether it is in force, as far as the catalogue has checked (as on the record).

current.description: When it has been repealed or replaced: the record in force in its place now, at the end of its line of repeals (up to three steps). Absent when nothing in the catalogue repealed it.

items.title: Items
items.description: This page's links, from the record's side, in this order: a judgment is `overruled_by`, `doubted_by`, `distinguished_by`, `applied_by` or `followed_by` a later judgment; it is `repealed_by`, `superseded_by`, `amended_by` or `commenced_by` a later record; it is `made_under` a parent law, or `transposes`, `domesticates`, `implements` or `ratifies` a treaty or directive; it `repeals`, `supersedes`, `amends` or `commences` another record; a treaty or directive is `transposed_by`, `domesticated_by`, `implemented_by` or `ratified_by` a law; a judgment `overrules`, `doubts`, `distinguishes`, `applies` or `follows` another; a `cross_reference`; it `cites` or is `cited_by` another record; it `enables` an instrument made under it. Then by ID, and a judgment's citations in the order of its paragraphs.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass it as `cursor` for the next page; absent on the last.

id.title: Id
id.description: The record's ID, such as `ng-foi-act-2011`. It doesn't change.

authority_id.title: Authority Id
authority_id.description: The authority that issued it, such as a legislature or ministry.

url_kind.title: Url Kind
url_kind.description: What `canonical_url` is: `document` (the file itself), `landing_page` (the official page for it) or `discovery` (an official listing where it can be found).

legal_status.title: Legal Status
legal_status.description: Whether it is in force, as far as the catalogue has checked: `current`, `historical`, `repealed`, `superseded` or `unknown`.

status_evidence.title: Status Evidence
status_evidence.description: An official link supporting the legal status, when there is one.

catalogue_note.title: Catalogue Note
catalogue_note.description: A public caveat about this record, when there is one.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: One sentence on what it is.

year.title: Year
year.description: The year it was made, when known.

regional.description: For a regional instrument: the organ that adopted it, its legal effect, the member states it binds and its transposition deadline, as its record states them.

treaty.description: For a treaty: its status as its record states it, with each party's signature, ratification, accession and denunciation, its reservations and the acts that domesticate it.

access_mode.title: Access Mode
access_mode.description: `open_full_text` when a text is cleared for reuse here; `metadata_link_only` when only the record and the official link are.

rights_status.description: The rights decision for its text: `OPEN`, `OPEN_WITH_CONDITIONS`, `LINK_ONLY`, `RESTRICTED` or `RIGHTS_UNDER_REVIEW`.

has_full_text.title: Has Full Text
has_full_text.description: Whether Get a record's texts returns a text for it.

value.title: Value
value.description: The date (for a month or a year, its first day), when the record gives one.

precision.title: Precision
precision.description: How precise it is: `day`, `month` or `year`. A date is compared with another only where its precision allows.

printed.title: Printed
printed.description: The date as printed, when the record keeps it.

StatedDateView.title: StatedDateView
StatedDateView.description:
A reviewed date as its record gives it: the date, how precise it is, and as printed when the record
keeps that. A date with no normalised value is never compared with another.

content_hash.title: Content Hash
content_hash.description: The `content_hash` of the text the offsets refer to.

total.title: Total
total.description: How many parts the text has.

items.title: Items
items.description: This page's parts, in document order.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; absent on the last page.

StructurePage.title: StructurePage
StructurePage.description: A page of one text version's structure in document order (API-02 /versions/{id}/structure).

id.title: Id
id.description: The suspension's ID: its membership and its number, such as `ga:aa-au:1:s1`.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: `suspended_from_participation`: the member may not take part in the body's activities. It remains a member.

valid_from.title: Valid From
valid_from.description: The first day of the suspension, as an EDTF date.

valid_from_bounds.description: The earliest and latest day `valid_from` can be, and its precision.

valid_to.title: Valid To
valid_to.description: Its last day, once lifted (a suspension lifted on 30 April ends on the 29th); null while it lasts.

valid_to_bounds.description: The earliest and latest day `valid_to` can be, and its precision; null while it lasts.

in_effect.title: In Effect
in_effect.description: Whether it was in effect on `as_of`; null when that date falls inside an uncertain first or last day.

legal_basis.title: Legal Basis
legal_basis.description: The articles it rests on: the one its decision cites (`decision_basis`), always, and the treaty's rule it applies (`treaty_rule`), where there is one.

evidence_url.title: Evidence Url
evidence_url.description: The decision that suspended the member.

lifted_evidence_url.title: Lifted Evidence Url
lifted_evidence_url.description: The decision that lifted it, once lifted.

note.title: Note
note.description: What the evidence says, and anything a reader should know.

SuspensionView.title: SuspensionView
SuspensionView.description:
A reviewed suspension of a member from participation in a body's activities: context for its
membership, which it never ends. Its first and last day (inclusive; none: not lifted), each an EDTF
date with its bounds, whether it was in effect on the date asked (``null``: the date falls inside an
uncertain start or end), its legal basis (the article its decision cites and any treaty rule it
applies), the decision that suspended it, the one that lifted it, and who reviewed it when.

anchor_id.title: Anchor Id
anchor_id.description: The part the passage is in: `/anchors/{anchor_id}` gives it whole.

citation.title: Citation
citation.description: The record's citation and the part's pinpoint.

pinpoint.title: Pinpoint
pinpoint.description: How the part is cited within the text, such as `s. 23`, when it has a number.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: What the part is, such as `section` or `article`.

locator.title: Locator
locator.description: The part's stable key within the text.

heading.title: Heading
heading.description: The part's printed heading, when it has one.

year.title: Year
year.description: The year the law was made, when known.

effective_from.title: Effective From
effective_from.description: The date the text applies from, when known.

effective_until.title: Effective Until
effective_until.description: The date the text applies until, when known.

start_byte.title: Start Byte
start_byte.description: Where the searched passage starts: a byte offset into the text in UTF-8.

snippet.title: Snippet
snippet.description: Words from the passage, exactly as in the text: its bytes from `snippet_start_byte` to `snippet_end_byte`.

snippet_start_byte.title: Snippet Start Byte
snippet_start_byte.description: Where the snippet starts in the text.

snippet_end_byte.title: Snippet End Byte
snippet_end_byte.description: Where the snippet ends in the text.

highlights.title: Highlights
highlights.description: The matching words, as [start, end] byte offsets into the text.

matched_by.title: Matched By
matched_by.description: `citation` (the words cite this part) or `text` (its words match).

score.title: Score
score.description: Its relevance under `ranking`, from 0 to 1; absent for a citation match.

official_url.title: Official Url
official_url.description: The official file the text was read from.

licence.title: Licence
licence.description: The terms the text is published under.

attribution_required.title: Attribution Required
attribution_required.description: Whether quoting it must credit the source.

attribution_text.title: Attribution Text
attribution_text.description: The credit to give, when one is required.

applicability.description: With `scope=applicable`: how the record relates to the jurisdiction asked about, and what that rests on.

TextHit.title: TextHit
TextHit.description:
One passage of a published text that matches a search (OA-S1, RET-03): the part it is in, a
snippet of exact canonical bytes with its terms marked, and what quoting it asks for.

status.title: Status
status.description: `results`; `no_result` (published texts were searched and none matched); `unsupported_scope` (no published text in this scope); or `degraded` (the search could not run: see `notices`).

total_exact.title: Total Exact
total_exact.description: Whether `total` is exact; counting stops at 10,000.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; absent on the last. The first 1,000 passages are served.

citation.description: When the words read as a citation of a public record: what it resolves to.

analysis.title: Analysis
analysis.description: How each language's texts are matched: `english`, `french`, `portuguese` or `spanish` (by word stems, common words left out), `arabic` (by word stems, every word kept) or `simple` (word for word).

analyzer.title: Analyzer
analyzer.description: The version of the index's analysis.

ranking.title: Ranking
ranking.description: The ranking used: `oa-rank-1`, as the search guide describes.

notices.title: Notices
notices.description: Anything that limits these results, in sentences.

applicability.description: With `scope=applicable`: the widening applied, and what it rests on and left out.

TextSearchPage.title: TextSearchPage
TextSearchPage.description:
A page of a search over published texts' provisions (OA-S1). ``status`` tells no result apart from
a scope with no published text and from a search that could not run.

signed.description: When it signed. Signature alone never binds.

denounced.description: When its denunciation or withdrawal took effect.

domesticated_by.title: Domesticated By
domesticated_by.description: Acts of that state that a checked link records as domesticating the treaty.

TreatyPartyView.title: TreatyPartyView
TreatyPartyView.description:
One party to a treaty as its reviewed record lists it, with the acts of that state that a checked
link records as domesticating the treaty. Signature alone never binds (COR-01).

adopted_by.title: Adopted By
adopted_by.description: The body that adopted it, when recorded.

entered_into_force.description: When it entered into force, when the record gives one date for the whole treaty.

authentic_languages.title: Authentic Languages
authentic_languages.description: The languages in which its text is authentic.

parties.title: Parties
parties.description: On a record and its anchors: each party as its record lists it. Empty means none is recorded, never that it has none.

parties_complete_as_of.title: Parties Complete As Of
parties_complete_as_of.description: On a record and its anchors: the date the party list is complete as of, by the depositary's status list, when recorded. Until a list is complete on a date, a state missing from it is `unknown` on that date, never not a party.

parties_complete_evidence.description: Where the list is shown complete: the depositary's status list.

TreatyView.title: TreatyView
TreatyView.description:
A treaty's status, as its reviewed record states it (JUR-04, DAT-03). ``parties`` is on the record
and its anchors, never on an evidence unit; an empty list means none is recorded, never none exists.
Beside it, the date the list is complete as of and where that is shown, when recorded: without it, a
state missing from the list is unknown, never not a party.

items.title: Items
items.description: The text versions cleared for reuse, each with its full text.

structure.title: Structure
structure.description: The parts, chapters and sections of these texts.

notice.title: Notice
notice.description: Why no text is shown, when none is.

selection.description: When `as_of` or `language` was given: which text they select, or the alternatives and why.

version_id.title: Version Id
version_id.description: The selected text, when there is one.

alternatives.title: Alternatives
alternatives.description: The texts that could each be the one, when several could.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why there is not one text: `several_languages`, `several_texts`, `effective_dates_unknown` (a text has no effective date, so whether it is in force can't be said), `none_in_language` or `none_in_force`.

VersionSelection.title: VersionSelection
VersionSelection.description:
Which text a date and a language select (API-02, OA-T3): one, alternatives with the reason, or
none. Never an arbitrary preference: a text with no effective date is never taken to be in force.

id.title: Id
id.description: The version's ID.

canonical_url.title: Canonical Url
canonical_url.description: The official file the text was read from.

retrieved_at.title: Retrieved At
retrieved_at.description: When the file was fetched from the official source.

raw_hash.title: Raw Hash
raw_hash.description: SHA-256 of the file as fetched.

content_hash.title: Content Hash
content_hash.description: SHA-256 of `canonical_text` in UTF-8. Check your copy against it.

parser.title: Parser
parser.description: The software that read the file into text.

effective_from.title: Effective From
effective_from.description: The date this text applies from, when known.

effective_until.title: Effective Until
effective_until.description: The date this text applies until, when known.

verification_status.title: Verification Status
verification_status.description: Whether the text was checked against the official file: `pending`, `verified` or `rejected`.

serialization_profile.title: Serialization Profile
serialization_profile.description: How the text was built from the reviewed pages, such as `oa-text-1/workbench-units-1`, when recorded.

prior_version_id.title: Prior Version Id
prior_version_id.description: The earlier version of the same record this one corrects or replaces, if any.

expression_id.title: Expression Id
expression_id.description: The language edition the text belongs to: `{source_id}:{language}`.

expression_authority.title: Expression Authority
expression_authority.description: What that edition is worth as law, as the record states it: `authoritative`, `equally_authentic`, `official_translation`, `unofficial_translation`, `machine_translation`, or `unknown` when nothing is recorded. Never implied by which text is preferred or selected.

expression_authority_evidence.description: Where that authority is stated, when recorded.

Problem.description: A refusal (RFC 9457). Its `code` is explained at https://open.alvary.ai/docs/errors.

type.description: A link to the code's explanation.

detail.description: What happened and what to do, in a sentence.

retryable.description: Whether the same request may succeed later.

request_id.description: Quote it when you ask us about this request.

retry_after_seconds.description: When to try again, as Retry-After.

ChangeWork.description: The record a change is about.

id.description: The record's ID.

legal_status.description: Whether it is in force now, as the catalogue has it: `current`, `historical`, `repealed`, `superseded` or `unknown`.

api_url.description: The record in this API: Get a record.

schema_version.description: The version of this shape, `change-event-1`. New event types and fields may appear within a version: ignore the ones you do not know.

event_revision.description: 1, or higher when we corrected the change itself (see `supersedes`).

event_type.description: What changed: `catalogue_added` (a record added: an old law newly catalogued, not a new law), `metadata_corrected` (its catalogue details corrected), `text_version_published`, `legal_effect_recorded` (a checked link with another public record that changes what law applies: a repeal, amendment, supersession, commencement, transposition, domestication or ratification; or a reviewed event on its provisions), `treatment_recorded` (a reviewed judicial treatment: how a judgment's paragraph follows, applies, distinguishes, doubts or overrules another judgment), `withdrawal` (a record or text), `coverage_changed` (a jurisdiction's coverage), `membership_recorded` (a reviewed membership of the African Union or a regional body recorded, ended or corrected) or `suspension_recorded` (a reviewed suspension of a member from participation in a body's activities recorded, lifted or corrected; it remains a member). More types may be added: ignore those you do not know; `/change-coverage` lists the ones recorded.

feed_epoch.description: The feed's epoch; it changes only when the feed is reset.

publication_revision.description: The catalogue's revision it was made in.

observed_at.description: When the change was seen at the official source, if known.

publisher_published_at.description: When the publisher published it, if known.

legal_effective.description: When it takes legal effect, if known: {from, until, precision}. A membership's or suspension's dates are EDTF dates, each stating its own precision (a window `[FIRST..LAST]` holds one day); `precision` is that of `from`.

work.description: The record, or null when it may no longer be named.

version.description: For a published or withdrawn text: {id, content_hash, language}.

rights_revision.description: For a published or withdrawn text: the revision of the record's rights record in force (see `/rights/{source_id}/history`).

changed_fields.description: For a correction: the fields that changed. A correction never changes legal text.

change_reason.description: Why, when known: `restored`, `first_text`, `source_revision`, `extraction_correction`, `redaction`, `corrected`, `ended` (a membership ended), `lifted` (a suspension lifted) or `unknown`.

supersedes.description: For a corrected change: the {event_id, event_revision} it replaces.

summary.description: One plain sentence saying what changed.

withdrawal.description: For a withdrawal: {scope_disclosure, action, reason_code}. A text version withdrawn from a record that stays public is `named`, with the version in `version`, `action` `stop_serving` (stop serving copies of that text) and `reason_code` `rights_changed` (its rights record changed or lapsed) or `correction` (its approval was withdrawn). When `scope_disclosure` is `revalidate_releases`, check your copies against a current release.

legal_effect.description: For a legal effect: {kind, by, effective_date, evidence_url}. `kind` is `repeal`, `amendment`, `supersession`, `commencement`, `transposition`, `domestication` or `ratification` of the record in `work`; `by` is the record that had the effect {id, title, citation}; the date is when it took effect, when known. A reviewer checked it against the official text. A transposition, domestication or ratification changes the law on both sides, so the law that gives effect to the instrument has its own change, naming the instrument in `of` {id, title, citation} instead of `by`. A later correction of it has the same `event_id`; when the link was withdrawn, the correction says `review_state` `withdrawn` and names the link it withdraws. For a reviewed event on provisions, `kind` is the event (`commenced`, `repealed`, `suspended`, `revived`, …), with `scope` (`whole` or `explicit_nodes`), `provisions` (their locators), `precision` of the date and `review_state` (`withdrawn` when the event was withdrawn, or is no longer public); `by` is present when another law asserted it.

treatment.description: For a judicial treatment: {id, kind, assertion, of or by, citing_locator, citing_pinpoint, cited_locator, cited_pinpoint, opinion, review_level, evidence_url}. `kind` is `follows`, `applies`, `distinguishes`, `doubts` or `overrules`; `assertion` is `direct_treatment`, a reviewer's reading of the treating paragraph, never an inferred risk. The treating judgment's change names the judgment treated in `of` {id, title, citation}; an overruling has a change on the overruled judgment too, naming the overruling one in `by`. `citing_pinpoint` is the treating paragraph and `cited_pinpoint` the part treated; `opinion` is the one the paragraph is in (`majority`, `concurrence`, `dissent`, `plurality`, `order` or `unknown`); `review_level` is `doctrinal`. The passage itself is on the record's history. A later correction has the same `event_id`; when the treatment was withdrawn, it says `review_state` `withdrawn`.

membership.description: For a membership: {id, member, body, valid_from, valid_from_bounds, valid_to, valid_to_bounds, basis, evidence_url, retracted}. `member` and `body` are {id, name}; the dates are its first and last day (`valid_to` null: not ended), each an EDTF date (a day, a month, a year or a window holding the day) with its bounds {earliest, latest, precision}, as a reviewer checked them against the evidence; `basis` {kind, instrument, pinpoint, evidence_url} says why it starts then. A change with `change_reason` `ended` records its end; a later correction has the same `event_id`, and `retracted` true when the membership is no longer a reviewed fact.

suspension.description: For a suspension from participation: {id, kind, membership_id, member, body, valid_from, valid_from_bounds, valid_to, valid_to_bounds, legal_basis, evidence_url, lifted_evidence_url, retracted}. `legal_basis` lists each article {instrument, pinpoint, role, evidence_url}: `role` `decision_basis` for the one the decision cites, `treaty_rule` for the treaty's rule it applies; a change of their words alone is not announced. It never ends the membership, which no event changes. A change with `change_reason` `lifted` records its lifting; a later correction has the same `event_id`, and `retracted` true when it is no longer a reviewed fact.

previous.description: For a correction: the previous values of the fields that changed, among `legal_status`, `rights_status`, `document_type` and `year`.

version_diff.description: For a text that replaces an earlier one: {prior_version_id, added, removed, changed, truncated}, the locators of the provisions added, removed and changed (their words differ), in document order, at most 200 each.

events.description: This page's changes, oldest first. A page may be short or empty.

has_more.description: Whether to ask again with `next_cursor` now.

next_cursor.description: Send as `cursor` for the next page (within 15 minutes).

resume_token.description: Keep it; send it later for only newer changes.

jurisdictions.description: Per jurisdiction: {id, name, works, readable_works, last_change_at, last_checked_at, expected_cadence, known_gaps}.

id.description: The plan's ID, such as `starter`.

allowance.description: Its limits: requests_per_minute, burst, concurrency, bytes_per_day, jurisdictions (countries of your choice, when limited), watches (monitors), digest, shared_watches, webhook_endpoints.

listing.description: How the console shows it: order, for, price, action, note.

bytes.description: How data a day is counted: a token bucket holding one day's `bytes_per_day`, refilled evenly over 24 hours, charged with each response body's bytes as sent.

download_base.description: Where its files are; append `/` and a file name. `/downloads/…` needs no key; `/api/v1/bulk/…` (releases with full text) needs your key.

files.description: Its files, with their SHA-256 checksums.

RequestId.description: This answer's ID. Quote it when you ask us about a request.

RateLimit.description: What is left of your organisation's request allowance: `"organisation";r=<requests left>;t=<seconds until the burst is full again>`. On every answer counted against the allowance; not on a refusal made before it is counted, such as `401` or a `429` for the organisation's allowance.

RateLimitPolicy.description: Your organisation's request allowance: `"organisation";q=<burst>;w=<seconds for the burst to refill>`. Sent with `RateLimit`.

ETag.description: The answer's tag. Send it back as `If-None-Match`: if the answer is unchanged, it is `304` with no body.

FileETag.description: The file's tag, from its size and when it was written. Compare it with the tag of an earlier download; this route does not answer `If-None-Match`.

RetryAfter.description: How many seconds to wait before trying again.

RetryAfterWhenKnown.description: How many seconds to wait before trying again, when the service knows.

bearer.description: An API key (`oa_live_…`) from the console, or an access token from a connected app.
